newsitem.title: USA: Rochester Gas takes plant out of service.
newsitem.headline: Rochester Gas takes plant out of service.

text.p: Rochester Gas and Electric Corp said Monday it will take the Ginna nuclear plant out of service later this week to conduct tests on the plant transformer.
The company said tests will determine if the transformer needs repairs. When the tests will begin and how long they will take is still being developed, the company said.
RG&E said it is investigating what caused some impurities to form in the transformer oil. They were detected by a transformer monitor last week and have since stabilized, the company said.
RG&E said it is continuing to analyze the oil and is involved in discussions with the transformer manufacturer.
In the meantime, in order to reduce stress on the transformer, the company said the plant has been reduced to 80 percent of power.
